description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'Log' in the package 'com.example.android.common.logger'. It provides static methods for logging at various levels, and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log data forwarding. The class essentially wraps Android's native android.util.Log functionality to facilitate customized logging implementations and chaining.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for managing log nodes and providing static methods for logging at various levels in an Android environment.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode that is the head of the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the current LogNode for output, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level; overloaded to accept with or without Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level; overloaded to accept with or without Throwable.
